# Spec: Note sharing

Spec ID: SPEC-01
Status: draft
Supersedes: —

## Problem & user

notes-api today serves personal notes only: a caller can list, create and delete their own notes, and nothing else. A user who wants another person to see a note has no way to do so through the API and must copy the content out of the product by hand, which loses the link to the original and goes stale as soon as the note changes or is deleted. The request is that users be able to share notes.

## Goals / Non-goals

Goals:
- The owner of a note can give another person access to that note without copying its content.
- A person a note was shared with can retrieve it through the API.
- Access stays under the owner's control: deleting the note ends every recipient's access, and nobody but the owner can delete it.

Non-goals:
- Real-time collaborative editing (simultaneous edits, merge or conflict handling).
- Notifications to recipients (email, push, webhooks) — see OQ-12.
- Sharing with groups, teams or organisations.
- Recipients sharing a note onward (re-sharing).
- A user interface — notes-api is an HTTP API; clients are outside this spec.
- Editing notes in general: the API has no update operation today, and adding one is a separate feature unless OQ-2 decides recipients get edit access.

## User stories

- US-1: As a note owner (an authenticated API caller), I want to share one of my notes with another person, so that they can read it without me copying it.
- US-2: As a recipient (an authenticated API caller), I want to list the notes shared with me, so that I can read them.
- US-3: As a note owner, I want to see who a note is shared with and revoke their access, so that I control who can read it.
- US-4: As a note owner, I want deleting my note to end all access to it, so that deleted content does not stay visible to others.

## Acceptance criteria (EARS)

### Contract

- [ ] AC-1 The API shall expose the operations "share a note", "list a note's recipients", "revoke a recipient" and "list notes shared with me" at [NEEDS CLARIFICATION: which routes? — OQ-10].
- [ ] AC-2 A share shall give its recipient [NEEDS CLARIFICATION: read-only access, or read and edit access? — OQ-2] to exactly one note.
- [ ] AC-3 Only the owner of a note shall be able to create, list or revoke the shares of that note.
